entries.EN: Trader: "...my guys were coming back from an assignment and disappeared. One of them - called Nimble - was bringing me some info...And they all disappeared really close by because they missed the bridge. Don't know what to think. Anyway: find Nimble, dead or alive, just as long as he has the flash drive. Bring it to me. Nimble was one of Wolf's men - and Wolf is here in the camp. Ask him, he probably knows something. He'll help you with weapons and gear."
entries.JA_current: 商人「俺の連中が仕事の帰りに行方をくらました。そのうちの1人、ニンブルが情報を運んでいたんだ。橋を越え損ねて、すぐ近くで消息を絶ったらしい。何があったのか見当もつかん。とにかくニンブルを探せ。生きていようが死んでいようが、フラッシュドライブさえ持っていればいい。そいつを俺に届けてくれ。ニンブルはウルフの部下だ。ウルフならこのキャンプにいるから、話を聞け。何か知っているだろうし、武器や装備も用意してくれるはずだ」

entries.EN:
At first there were only five of us, those most desperate and willing to do anything for the Truth. Why do we want to go there, anyway? What do we want to discover there? None of us know, not Green, not Romantic, not me, not even the Captain. I did not ask anyone, but simply decided for myself: to imagine that there, in the Center of the Zone - lays a brighter future. A chance for a good life which I had beyond the perimeter, and which my enemies ruined. Let it be so, and if not, I can take a bullet to the head.\n \n
		%c[255,255,128,0]I stashed some goodies under a spruce on a high hill north-east of the carpark infested with bandits.%c[default]

entries.EN:
We are making heavy preparations for the expedition to the North. With the money raised from the sale of our loot, we acquire supplies, weapons and ammunition by the crate-load. Duty helped us a little with this - they threw in a couple of old maps and some spare ammunition. We should also make note of a new contributor - a veteran nicknamed Raven. He came to our leader and on behalf of the Hunters' community presented us with a set of armor and weapon repair kits. I think they will definitely be of use in the future. I wish there were more like-minded people! The captain tried to persuade Raven to join our expedition, but he declined, since he seems to be suffering from health problems after the mutant attack.\n \n
		%c[255,255,128,0]I hid some of my gear near the fence on the north side of the newcomers' camp, under a large dry bush.%c[default]

entries.EN:
Subject: A stalker named Strelok. 
 Approximate physical description: Short stature, thin build, haggard appearance. Receding hairline, black hair, sharp nose, gray eyes. No image available, description gathered from secondary HUMINT sources, reliability questionable. 
 Exercise extreme caution at contact: intel indicates the subject is highly trained and experienced in combat, prior military experience likely although unconfirmed. Subject has a legendary reputation with the locals due to his apparently successful attempts at penetrating into the CNPP premises. 
 Primary Objective: Locate and secure dead drop containing equipment considered essential for operation in the AO. The cache is camouflaged in accordance with SOP and located 2km NNE, Azimuth 20 degrees, from the point of insertion. Approximate location marked on GPS with radial geographical margin of error between 10-20m.
